# Overview
::: {.lead}
Browse all workshops and exercises in the four-part course. Selecting a part or tag filters the network, the activity list, and the chip counts together. Click any node in the graph to open the activity; shift-click adds its part to the filter, alt-click adds its tags.
:::
:::

## Learning network

::: {.network-help}
Each node is an activity; nodes share an edge when they have tags in common (solid edges: two or more; dashed edges: one). Colour encodes part. Non-matching nodes fade rather than disappear so the layout stays stable as you filter.
:::

::: {#tutorial-network style="height: 560px;"}
:::
